title: What If a Volcano Was Born in a Farmer's Cornfield?
subject: Paricutin volcano

scenes.text: What if a volcano was born in a farmer's cornfield? In Mexico in 1943, one was.
Farmer Dionisio Pulido watched the ground in his field swell, crack and start to smoke.
It grew fast, and within a year it stood over 300 meters tall.
It kept erupting for nine years, finishing at 424 meters tall.
Lava and ash buried the nearby towns, but the slow-moving lava meant no one died.
It was the first volcano scientists could study from birth to death, all from one cornfield.

description:
